data.one_liner: Access shared app group container on iOS & macOS
data.what_it_does: Provides a simple API to retrieve the path of a shared application group directory. It works on iOS and macOS, enabling data sharing between an app and its extensions.
use_when: You need to share files or data between an app and its extensions on iOS or macOS
You require a single, platform‑specific directory for group storage
avoid_when: You are targeting Android, Linux, Windows, or web
strengths: No extra build_runner or code generation
weaknesses: Only works on iOS and macOS
No support for Android or other platforms
